title: Senior Product Manager- Funnel & Growth
description:
**About Us**


Pluang is Indonesia’s leading multi\-asset investment platform, offering products such as Crypto, US Stocks, Indonesian Stocks, Mutual Funds, and Gold. Our mission is to make investing accessible, seamless, and secure—so more Indonesians can achieve financial independence. Backed by $110M\+ in funding from global investors like Accel and Openspace Ventures, we’re one of Indonesia’s fastest\-growing fintechs.


**Role Overview**


We are hiring a Senior Product Manager based in **Gurgaon** to own Pluang’s Funnel \& Growth (FnG) charter across the full lifecycle: Acquisition, Activation, Retention, and Conversion. You will set the growth product strategy, build scalable growth systems (journey optimization, instrumentation, experimentation, lifecycle management), and lead cross\-functional execution across Product, Engineering, Data, Design, and Marketing. This is a high\-impact leadership role with direct influence on revenue, transaction volume, and user growth.

  

  

**What You Will Do**


**1\) Own growth strategy \& operating cadence across Acquisition, Activation, Retention, and Conversion (AI as a capability)**

  

* Define FnG strategy, priorities, and roadmap; align stakeholders on tradeoffs and sequencing.
  
* Establish a strong growth operating system: weekly metrics, reviews, and clear accountability.
  
* Build AI leverage into growth workflows (e.g., automated funnel anomaly detection, faster insight generation, variant generation \+ quality checks, lifecycle personalization).
  

**2\) Increase app installs through product\-led loops and/or marketing performance infrastructure**

  

* Drive step\-function growth in installs by owning product\-led acquisition loops (e.g., referrals, SEO/AEO landing experiences, shareable content/artifacts, AI content generation engine)
  
* Partner with Marketing to build product infrastructure that improves paid performance (e.g., attribution quality, campaign\-to\-cohort visibility, landing flow conversion improvements).
  
* Ensure install growth is measured with incrementality and quality (downstream activation, KYC, first trade, retention).
  

**3\) Improve funnel conversion via instrumentation, experimentation, and personalization**

  

* Own end\-to\-end funnel health and conversion improvements across onboarding KYC first trade repeat trade.
  
* Run a high\-velocity experimentation program with strong rigor (test design, guardrails, interpretation, and rollout).
  
* Ship personalization that compounds: targeted journeys, contextual nudges, dynamic offers—grounded in measurable lift.
  

**4\) Build cohorting \+ lifecycle systems that scale engagement and retention**

  

* Define and evolve cohorting (intent/value/behavior/asset affinity) that drives targeted experiences and prioritization.
  
* Build lifecycle journeys that reduce drop\-offs and increase habit formation (e.g., education, alerts, portfolio habits).
  
* Partner with Data/Eng to ensure the lifecycle engine is measurable, reliable, and operationally scalable.
  

**5\) Scale referral \+ influencer growth routes with sustainable economics and controls**

  

* Own referral product mechanics end\-to\-end: incentives, UX, fraud/risk controls, and inviter/invitee economics.
  
* Build tooling that enables influencer programs to scale (tracking, attribution, reward logic, performance insights).
  

  

**6\) Lead cross\-functional execution and raise the growth bar**

  

* Drive alignment across Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, and Compliance to ship impactful growth initiatives.
  
* Mentor PM(s) and standardize best practices in experimentation quality, analytics hygiene, and execution cadence.
  
* Translate strategy into shippable roadmaps and ensure outcomes are realized (not just launched).
  

  

**What You Will Need**


**Qualifications**

  

* **4\+ years** of Product Management experience, with meaningful ownership in growth / funnel / lifecycle.
  
* Demonstrated impact on acquisition, activation, retention, and conversion metrics at scale.
  
* Fintech, trading, or consumer financial products experience is strongly preferred.
  
* Marketing or Product Marketing experience (preferred)—especially performance marketing collaboration, lifecycle, GTM, or positioning.
  

**Skills \& Competencies**

  

* Strong analytical and experimentation depth (cohort analysis, incrementality, A/B testing rigor).
  
* Ability to build systems: instrumentation standards, experimentation pipelines, lifecycle/personalization engines.
  
* Excellent cross\-functional leadership and stakeholder management in fast\-moving environments.
  
* Practical fluency in applying AI to product and operations (e.g., content pipelines, evaluation/monitoring, automated insighting)—without treating AI as a vanity requirement.
  

**Mindset**

  

* High ownership, strong product judgment, and comfort operating in ambiguity.
  
* Bias for outcomes and compounding leverage over one\-off wins.

title: Storyteller & Script Writer
description:
Storyteller \& Script Writer

**Company:** HypeSquad Digital Solutions  
**Position:** Storyteller \& Script Writer  
**Experience:** 2–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Location:** Delhi NCR / Work From Office  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month  
**Department:** Content \& Creative

About HypeSquad

HypeSquad Digital Solutions is a Digital Growth Systems Agency helping businesses build brands, generate leads, create content, and build scalable digital growth systems.

We are looking for a **creative Storyteller \& Script Writer** who understands how to turn an idea, product, service, or insight into content that people actually want to watch.

This is not a traditional blog\-writing role.

We need someone who understands **attention, storytelling, hooks, emotions, pacing, and audience psychology** — especially for short\-form video.

Role Overview

As a Storyteller \& Script Writer, you will work closely with our creative, marketing, and performance teams to develop scripts and content concepts for:

* Instagram Reels
* YouTube Shorts
* Facebook
* LinkedIn
* Paid advertisements
* Brand videos
* Founder\-led content
* Educational content
* Product/service videos
* Social media campaigns

Your job will be to take a **raw idea and turn it into a compelling story.**

The basic thinking should be:

**Hook → Problem → Story → Insight → Solution → CTA**

But you should also know when to break the formula.

Key Responsibilities1\. Short\-Form Video Scripts

Write engaging scripts for:

* Instagram Reels
* YouTube Shorts
* Facebook videos
* LinkedIn videos
* Talking\-head videos
* Educational videos
* Story\-based videos
* Promotional videos
* Brand awareness content
* Lead\-generation content

Scripts should be designed around **retention and engagement**, not just information delivery.

2\. Storytelling

Convert ordinary information into interesting stories.

For example:

Instead of:

"Businesses need a website."

You should be able to develop:

"A client came to us after spending ₹2 lakh on ads. The ads weren't the problem. The website was."

The candidate should understand how to create:

* Curiosity
* Suspense
* Emotional connection
* Relatability
* Pattern interruption
* Open loops
* Strong payoffs

3\. Hooks

Develop multiple hooks for the same idea.

Examples:

* Curiosity\-based hooks
* Problem\-based hooks
* Contrarian hooks
* Emotional hooks
* Data\-driven hooks
* Story hooks
* Question hooks
* Pattern\-interrupt hooks

You should understand that **the first 2–3 seconds can determine whether someone keeps watching.**

4\. Research \& Content Discovery

Research:

* Trending topics
* Industry news
* Competitor content
* Social media trends
* Viral formats
* Audience pain points
* Consumer behaviour
* Relevant case studies

Turn research into original content ideas rather than simply copying existing content.

5\. Content Ideation

Generate content ideas for different brands and industries.

You should be comfortable moving between:

**Marketing → Business → Technology → Education → Lifestyle → Products → Services**

and quickly understanding the audience and communication style required for each.

6\. Ad Scripts

Create scripts specifically designed for performance marketing.

This includes:

* Meta video ads
* YouTube ads
* Lead\-generation ads
* Product/service ads
* Retargeting creatives
* UGC\-style ads
* Founder\-led ads

You should understand the difference between a **content reel** and a **conversion\-focused ad.**

7\. Brand Storytelling

Help develop:

* Brand stories
* Founder stories
* Customer stories
* Case studies
* Testimonials
* Brand campaigns
* Launch campaigns

The objective is to make brands **memorable, relatable, and differentiated.**

8\. Collaboration

Work closely with:

* Performance Marketers
* Graphic Designers
* Video Editors
* Social Media Managers
* Website Developers
* Founders / Clients

You will need to convert creative ideas into scripts that are practical to shoot and edit.

What We Are Looking ForMandatory Skills

* 2–3 years of relevant experience
* Strong storytelling ability
* Excellent Hindi and English communication
* Strong script\-writing skills
* Understanding of short\-form content
* Strong research skills
* Understanding of social media content
* Ability to write strong hooks
* Ability to understand different audiences
* Ability to write conversational scripts

Preferred Experience

Experience with:

* Digital marketing agencies
* Social media agencies
* Content creators
* Personal brands
* D2C brands
* Startups
* Performance marketing
* Advertising
* YouTube/Instagram content

is a plus.

What Makes You a Good Fit?

You should be someone who naturally asks:

**"Why would someone care about this?"**

before asking:

**"What should I write?"**

You should be able to take:

**One idea → 5 hooks → 3 angles → 2 scripts → multiple pieces of content.**

You should also be comfortable rewriting a script based on performance data.

For example:

Low retention at 5 seconds → improve hook.High retention but low CTA response → improve offer/CTA.High views but low leads → improve intent and conversion angle.Daily Responsibilities

Your typical day may include:

* Researching content trends
* Finding interesting stories and topics
* Creating content ideas
* Writing short\-form scripts
* Writing ad scripts
* Developing hooks
* Reviewing competitor content
* Working with the video team
* Improving existing scripts
* Participating in creative brainstorming
* Supporting campaign content development

Expected Output

The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced content environment with multiple scripts and concepts being developed every week.

Quality is more important than simply producing a high number of scripts.

We want **ideas that people remember.**

Candidate Evaluation

During the hiring process, candidates may be asked to complete a short practical assignment.

Example:

**Topic:** "Why most businesses waste money on digital marketing."

Create:

* 5 hooks
* 1 × 45\-second Reel script
* 1 × 30\-second ad script
* 1 × storytelling angle
* CTA

Candidates may also be asked to rewrite an existing script to improve its hook and retention.

Required Qualities

* Creative thinker
* Curious
* Strong communicator
* Good observer
* Research\-oriented
* Audience\-focused
* Comfortable experimenting
* Open to feedback
* Deadline\-oriented
* Strong attention to detail
* Understands internet culture and social media
* Can think beyond conventional content formats

Compensation

**₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month**

Final compensation will depend on:

* Experience
* Writing quality
* Storytelling ability
* Portfolio
* Industry exposure
* Practical assignment performance

How to Apply

Please share:

* Updated CV
* Writing portfolio
* Previous scripts
* Links to reels/videos you have scripted, if available
* Relevant social media/content work
* Notice period
* Current compensation
* Expected compensation

**Subject:** Application — Storyteller \& Script Writer

Important

**We are not looking for a content writer who simply fills a content calendar.**

We are looking for a **storyteller who can turn ideas into content people want to watch, remember, and share.**

The Supply Chain Digitalization Analyst supports the execution of the Supply Chain Digitalization strategy by maintaining high\-quality Supply Chain data and delivering advanced analytics, insights, and Power BI solutions. Working under the direction of the SC Digitalization Manager, the role helps ensure data is structured, consistent, governed, and usable across systems to support operational performance, planning, service, inventory, working capital, and cost optimization. The Analyst also supports the lifecycle management of dashboards and analytical tools aligned with global Supply Chain priorities.

  


**Key Responsibilities:**


* **Supply Chain Data Maintenance, Quality \& Governance:** Maintain, cleanse, harmonize, and improve Supply Chain data across operational, planning, inventory, service, cost, working capital, and performance domains. Resolve data inconsistencies through root cause analysis and sustainable fixes, while supporting Data Governance standards, definitions, documentation, and issue escalation.
* **Analytics Solution Development, Data Modeling \& Digital Tools:** Translate Supply Chain requirements into data models, semantic models, Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions aligned with data strategy and architecture. Partner with stakeholders to support Power BI builds and scalable analytics solutions using tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and Power Platform / PowerApps, where applicable.
* **Reporting Lifecycle, Automation \& Standardization**: Maintain and improve global and regional Supply Chain scorecards, dashboards, and recurring reports. Manage refresh validation, issue resolution, enhancements, documentation, user support, KPI alignment, and report consolidation, while driving automation and standardization to improve scalability and consistency.
* **Advanced Analytics, Data\-Driven Insights \& Supply Chain Optimization:** Develop advanced analytics and network optimization models using complex Supply Chain data to improve operational performance, planning, service, inventory, working capital, cost, and risk management. Partner with internal Supply Chain and cross\-functional teams gather data, maintain accurate baseline network models, evaluate customer shipping points, and assess strategic network opportunities, including greenfield locations and point\-of\-manufacturing options.
